summary: An Abu Dhabi law firm appears to lose clients to a typo in its page title, a free builder address and a 2019 date.

findings.problem: The page title appears as Laywers UAE Dubai, a misspelling of Lawyers, and it names Dubai for an Abu Dhabi firm.
findings.cost: This is the title Google and browser tabs show, so people searching for a lawyer see a typo and may not find you.
findings.fix: A correct title with your firm name and city.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: Clients check a law firm's credibility first, and a free builder address looks temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a firm email.

findings.problem: The page appears to carry a 2019 copyright date.
findings.cost: An old date tells a visitor the firm may not be active, so they call a competitor.

findings.problem: The only contact shown appears to be a gmail address and one landline, with no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Many clients in the UAE message first on WhatsApp, and a free email gives less trust.
findings.fix: A firm email and a one tap WhatsApp button.
